caption: The drawing depicts a detailed, ornate cast iron hall rack rendered in black ink lines on a beige paper background. The central vertical column features elaborate scrollwork and decorative motifs, including two shield-like emblems in the middle section. The rack has several branches extending horizontally from the central column at different heights, each with multiple hooks for hanging items. At the top, the branches curve upward and outward, each ending in a small, rounded hook. The lower part of the rack includes additional curved arms. Toward the base, there are symmetrical patterns with three sculpted faces integrated into the design. The rack stands in a rectangular tray-like base with raised edges and decorative detailing. To the right of the image, the words “CAST IRON HALL RACK” appear in uppercase letters. An arrow at the left with a measurement indicates the rack’s height as 86 inches.
title: Cast Iron Hat Rack
